title: Movie Booking: Waitlist, Pricing Rules, and Showtimes
description: Add waitlist when sold out, dynamic pricing, and showtime search.

data.text: Extend the booking system with a waitlist for sold-out shows, dynamic pricing based on seat location and demand, and a search for showtimes by movie and date.

data.title: Waitlist and Dynamic Pricing
Why separate ISeatPricingStrategy?
data.text: Pricing rules change frequently: premium rows, group discounts, matinee pricing, loyalty multipliers. Strategy keeps Show agnostic to business rules.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: WaitlistEntry preserves order for sold-out shows
Promote from waitlist when a seat opens up (cancellation)
ShowtimeSearch filters by movie, date, and screen
data.takeaway: Booking systems need waitlists and dynamic pricing to maximize revenue. Strategy and Queue patterns keep the core model clean.
